notes.title: Back us on Kickstarter on November 10th
notes.notes:
We are extremely excited to announce, that we will launch our Kickstarter campaign on [b]November 10[/b]!
Thanks for love and support from everyone helps us reach this important milestone.
One thing we want to reveal about the Kickstarter, is there will be an EARLY-BIRD reward with only 500 backers limited, which includes following items:
[b][list]
[*] Digital wallpaper pack.
[*] DISCORD server invite with “Early Supporter” role.
[*] 1 digital download key on Steam.
[*] 1 extra digital download key on either Xbox or PlayStation after release.
[*] Beta access immediately after Kickstarter.
[/list][/b]
Only [b]US$50[/b] to own all these! Remember only the fastest 500 backers can have these!
Additionally, every backer who has subscribed to our newsletter will have two extra privileges:
[b][list]
[*] Permanently GOLD NICKNAME display in game.
[*] Getting DOUBLE EXPERIENCE for the first 3 months after final release on Steam to make you upgrade faster than others.
[/list][/b]
Help us to make this game come to full!
Thanks to you all!
Cheers!

notes.title: Preview 7 Released
notes.notes:
In this version we mainly improved the performance and graphics quality.

* Improve overall performance.
* Improve overall light quality.

- Remove dynamic moonlight.

+ Press F12 to switch graphics quality.

notes.title: Preview 6 Released
notes.notes:
The window vaulting feature added in this version is still a prototype. You may experience some issues when vaulting.

* Improve mantle experience.
* Item won't be dropped when opening doors.
* Boogeyman won't attack character through wall.
* Flare gun can cause damage to Boogeyman.
* Minor bug fixes and improvements.

+ Add window vaulting.
+ Add new icons to attributes and items.
+ Add using arrow keys to move character.
